content.text:
The bug was in `total()` in `src/cart.js`: it applied tax first and the discount second. The comment above the function says the discount comes off the pre-tax subtotal and tax applies to what is left. A discount larger than the subtotal also has to stop at zero instead of going negative.

The fix applies the discount to the subtotal first and clamps the result at 0 with `Math.max`. Tax is then applied to that amount.

`npm test` now passes all 243 tests. The two that failed were "fixed discount comes off before tax" and "fixed discount larger than subtotal gives zero". I didn't touch the tests.
